Scene 01

Opening scene

Dana Scully

For the first time... I feel time like a heartbeat, the seconds pumping in my breast like a reckoning, the numinous mysteries that once seemed so distant and unreal... Threatening clarity in the presence of a truth... Entertained not in youth, but only in its passage. I feel these words as if their meaning... Were weight being lifted from me, knowing that you will read them and share my burden... As I have come to trust no other. That you should know my heart, look into it, finding there the memory and experience that belong to you, that are you, is a comfort to me now as I feel the tethers loose... And the prospects darken... For the continuance of a journey that began not so long ago, and which began again with a faith shaken and strengthened... By your convictions. If not for which I might never have been so strong now... As I cross to face you and look at you incomplete, hoping that you will forgive me... For not making the rest of the journey with you.

Scene 02

HOLY CROSS MEMORIAL HOSPITAL

Fox Mulder

Oncology? Thanks. Scully? I, uh-- I stole these from some guy with a broken leg down the hall. He won't be able to catch me. How you doing?

Dana Scully

I guess that's the question. Actually, I feel fine.

Fox Mulder

Good. What, uh, exactly are we lookin' at here?

Dana Scully

It's what's called a naso-pharyngeal mass. It's a small growth on the wall... Between the superior concha and the sphenoidal sinus.

Fox Mulder

A growth?

Dana Scully

A tumor. You're the only one I've called.

Fox Mulder

Okay. Is it operable?

Dana Scully

No.

Fox Mulder

But it's treatable.

Dana Scully

The truth is that the type and placement of the tumor... Make it difficult-- to the extreme.

Fox Mulder

I refuse to believe that. I-I--

Dana Scully

For all the times I have said that to you, I am as certain about this as you have ever been. I have cancer. It is a mass on the wall between my sinus and cerebrum. If it pushes into my brain, statistically there is about zero chance of survival.

Fox Mulder

I don't accept that. Th-there must be some people... Who have received treatment for this who we can--

Dana Scully

Yes, there are.

[ sighs ]

Scene 03

SKINNER'S OFFICE

Walter Skinner

This news comes as the worst kind of surprise, agent Scully. I'm very sorry.

Dana Scully

Thank you, sir. I don't mean for this to be awkward, and I would appreciate it if we could keep this confidential.

Walter Skinner

I understand. I assume you'll be taking a leave of absence.

Dana Scully

No, sir. I've asked my doctors to hold on to my medical records... Until agent Mulder and I can exhaust a possible avenue of investigation.

Walter Skinner

Investigation?

Fox Mulder

Last year agent Scully and I... Pursued a case in which a number of women, purported abductees, experienced similar symptoms after having implants removed from the base of their necks. A woman in allentown, Pennsylvania... Named Betsy Hagopian, was undergoing treatment for naso-pharyngeal tumor. We haven't been able to contact her yet.

Walter Skinner

I'm sure you're aware we have contacts with the best physicians in the country.

Dana Scully

Yes, sir. But for my own reasons, I would like to pursue this through the justice department, rather than as a personal matter.

Scene 04

ALLENTOWN, PA

Realtor

I'm sorry. No early birds.

Dana Scully

We're not here for the garage sale. We're looking for Betsy Hagopian. No one's returning our messages.

Realtor

Sorry. Um, Betsy's passed away. Just two-and-a-half weeks ago. Are you a relation?

Fox Mulder

No. We're with the FBI.

Realtor

Been some kind of trouble?

Fox Mulder

Betsy was part of a MUFON group.

Realtor

I don't know. I'm just the realtor.

Fox Mulder

Do you mind if we come inside and take a look? Hey, Scully. Listen to this. [ static sounds ] there are two lines coming in. I noticed this one was lit.

Dana Scully

Somebody's sending a fax or a computer modem.

Fox Mulder

But who? And to send what? Somebody must have remote access to the system.

Dana Scully

They're downloading data.

Fox Mulder

Copying files. Let's get a trace on them before whoever it is hangs up.

[ dialing tone ]

Scene 05

FRONT OF APARTMENT BUILDING

Dana Scully

Apartment 234 is listed under Kurt Crawford.

Fox Mulder

I'm gonna check around back. See if you can get the manager.

Dana Scully

Stop! Federal agent! Hold it! Put your hands where we can see them! Is your name Kurt Crawford?

Kurt Crawford

Yes.

Scully?

Dana Scully

What? I'm fine, Mulder. Quit staring at me. I'm fine.

Scene 06

IN APARTMENT

[ knocking at door ]

Fox Mulder

You okay, Scully?

Dana Scully

Yeah. I'm just washing up. You took his cuffs off.

Fox Mulder

He says he's a member of the same UFO network Betsy Hagopian belonged to. That he was downloading files for safekeeping, as Betsy had instructed him.

Dana Scully

Then why did he run?

Fox Mulder

He thinks his life's in danger. He thinks there's a government conspiracy to suppress the information in those files.

Dana Scully

You think he's credible?

Fox Mulder

He seems to know a lot... About what happened to Betsy and the other women... In the MUFON group that you met at her house.

Dana Scully

That will have to be cross-checked.

Fox Mulder

We can't.

Dana Scully

Why not? How did they die?

Kurt Crawford

Brain cancer. All within the last year.

Dana Scully

All of them?

Kurt Crawford

From the group you met, there's only Penny Northern. She's in the hospital, and it doesn't look good.

Dana Scully

What makes you think this is a conspiracy, that the government's involved?

Kurt Crawford

What makes you think it isn't? Eleven women are abducted, all with similar recollections about the experience. All developing identical brain tumors, and all refused state or federal health care... Because of their insistence of the facts. And all dying within the space of a year.

[ whispering ]

Fox Mulder

I want you to listen to me.

Dana Scully

About what?

Fox Mulder

About what you won't admit to yourself, what you're denying.

Dana Scully

What am I denying?

Fox Mulder

Where your cancer came from.

Dana Scully

It doesn't matter.

Fox Mulder

It does matter. If what you have is a result of your abduction, and that is something the government knows, then those are facts that should be brought to light.

Dana Scully

I don't know what happened. I have no clear recollection, and I don't think these abductions are even abductions.

Fox Mulder

These women are dead.

Dana Scully

No, they are not. One woman isn't-- this Penny Northern.

Fox Mulder

Mm-hmm. If you won't listen to me, then you should go talk to her.

Dana Scully

About what? What it feels like to be dying of cancer? What it's like to know there is absolutely nothing you can do about it?

Fox Mulder

If that's too hard for you, then go as an investigator. You have one remaining witness, agent Scully. I'd think you'd want to know what her story is.

Yes. What did you want to ask me?

Scene 11

Scene 11

Dana Scully

In med school, I learned that cancer arrives in the body unannounced-- a dark stranger who takes up residence, turning its new home against itself. This is the evil of cancer--- that it starts as an invader, but soon becomes one with the invaded, forcing you to destroy it. But only at the risk of destroying yourself.

[ whirring ]

Dana Scully

It is science's demon possession. My treatments-- science's attempt at exorcism. Mulder, I hope that in these terms... You might know it and know me, and accept this stranger so many recognize... But cannot ever completely cast out. And if the darkness should have swallowed me as you read this, you must never think there was the possibility of some secret intervention-- something you might have done. And though we have traveled far together, this last distance must necessarily be traveled alone.

[ door opens, closes ]

Scene 18

Scene 18

Dana Scully

I have not written to you in the last 24 hours... Because the treatment has weakened my spirit as well as my body. Mulder, it's difficult to describe to you the fear of facing an enemy... Which I can neither conquer nor escape. Penny Northern has taken a downturn. I now look at her with a respect that can only come from one... Who is about to walk the same dark path. Seeing her, I can't help but see myself in a month or a year. I pray that I have her courage to face this journey. Mulder, I feel you close... Though I know you are now pursuing your own path. For that I am grateful-- more than I could ever express. I need to know you are out there if I am ever to see through this.
